method: Images kept by the weekly render-reuse run (project pages, at least 200 px, logos, flat graphics and site chrome dropped, at most 16 per project). kdh1 is a 64-bit difference hash: full-resolution decode, integer luma composited over white, 9x8 grid of exact cell means, bit = cell darker than its right neighbour. The same function runs in the browser (tools/image-check/kdh.js).
